d:
Let go of the tension and exhaustion you carried through the day so you can go to bed feeling calmer, looser, and more settled. This short evening practice uses gentle movement, easy stretching, and slower breathing to help you wind down after work, training, sitting, screens, or a day that simply took a lot out of you.
How you end today can shape how you meet tomorrow. Give yourself a few quiet minutes to come down from the day and head toward sleep feeling clear, centered, and ready to begin again.
